title: Enhancing gas sensing and optoelectronic properties of rutile TiO2 via transition metal doping: a DFT + U study
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,3325-3337
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08889E, Paper
Open Access

Lemma Tirfie Zegbreal, Newayemedhin Aberra, David E. Motaung, S. Z. Werta, Fekadu Gashaw Hone
This research employs DFT + U calculations to investigate the impact of doping with Co, Ni, Cu, and Zn on the structural, electronic, optical, and gas sensing characteristics of rutile TiO2.
